summary: Fleet shows device-only quality targets for the last hour and last 24 hours; the phone keeps bounded hourly summaries in local storage with the same shape and buckets as stui

schema.detail: No database or wire change. st3-views defines the shared version-1 local hourly JSON shape and initial targets.

compatibility.detail: Quality has no client, reporter or graph port. Storage failures are ignored; pending key and frame samples use fixed numeric storage. Draft text is saved under a separate local key, bounded and bound to the same actor.

manual.detail: Open Fleet to read Quality. Values use histogram bucket upper bounds and initial targets; no deployment or app installation is performed by this change.

recovery.detail: A stale foreground marker records a silent exit; fatal JavaScript errors record panics when storage completes. Saved drafts are restored for their original actor and counted after an unclean exit. An OS kill may lose the unfinished hour.
